summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an Appendix 2A application for quotation of 784,817 ordinary shares on the ASX, issued upon the vesting of employee performance rights. No cash consideration was involved; the shares rank equally with existing shares. This is a routine equity issuance under an employee incentive plan, not a special situation such as a capital return, restructuring, or going-private transaction. It is analogous to a US Form 8-K reporting an employee stock grant. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes—simply a standard securities quotation request.
